evidence.quote: The selection of applicants is based on the SAT test, which is an international test in English, managed by CollegeBoard and stands for “Scholastic Assessment Test.”

notes: More application rounds exist: the first selection (10/February/2026-04/May/2026) is the only one open to non-EU citizens residing abroad. Tuition not extracted: the several quote shows a fixed tuition from €157.04 to a maximum that varies depending on the programme, but no quote ties this programme to a group whose fee applies to this student; the reduced flat fee of €1,000 + €157.04 for non-OECD citizens (Morocco is listed) could not be tied to this programme with the required second quote in the same academic year, so it was left out. Language requirement not extracted for English. Translation/legalisation of the qualification may be required for the visa and for fee exemption documents, but this is not stated as an enrolment document requirement, so translationRequired for the diploma is given as true only via the visa documents quote; verify with the programme page.
